<reason>A won a close, high-quality clash by keeping the motion modest (know that ranking is happening, not the formula) and making consent/power the voting issue. B’s best hits—no clean seam, no score/fix, illusory exit, shame and gaming—were real, but they never defeated a limited right to name the scoring layer. B’s “empty of guidance, loaded as a signal” split was clever yet conceded that the fact matters, which A converted into the cleaner reason to affirm.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A’s empty-vs-powerful dilemma: if notice is inert, B’s obsession/gamer harms collapse; if it is potent, users are missing a fact about being ranked as inventory. B’s “both” answer never fully escaped that bind.</best_rebuttal>
